shortdesc.ph: Configures access to the Agora private media server access module.

section.p: After successfully deploying the Agora private media server and integrating the 4.x RTC SDK in the intranet client, you can call this method to specify the local access point and assign the access module to the SDK.

section.note: This method only takes effect after deploying the Agora hybrid cloud solution. Contact sales for more details and to deploy the hybrid cloud.
